values.meaning: aura bonus attack speed granted to Jarvan and allies near the deployed flag
values.quote: grants ''Demacian Standard's'' passive {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} to all nearby allied champions as well as '''Jarvan IV'''

values.meaning: total bonus attack speed Jarvan gains while near the flag (passive + aura stacked additively)
values.quote: '''Jarvan IV''' gains a total of {{ap|20*2 to 30*2}}% bonus attack speed from ''Demacian Standard'' while near the flag.
values.binNote: This is the wiki-stated sum of PermanentAttackSpeed and BaseAuraAS (each 0.2-0.3 by rank), doubled since both stack additively; no single bin row carries the combined total.

values.meaning: duration the flag remains, granting sight and the attack speed aura
values.quote: The flag then remains for 8 seconds
values.binNote: No bin row for the flag's lingering duration was found in the sheet; only the wall duration (R) and dash speed (E) are present, not this timer.

mechanics.claim: The attack speed granted from a deployed Demacian Standard stacks additively with the passive permanent bonus attack speed to Jarvan IV, but the aura from multiple Demacian Standards does not stack.
mechanics.quote: The attack speed granted from a deployed ''Demacian Standard'' {{tip|stacks additively}} with ''Demacian Standard's'' passive permanent bonus attack speed to '''Jarvan IV''', but the aura from multiple ''Demacian Standards'' does not stack.

mechanics.claim: The flag can be blocked by a spell shield.
The ability has no cast time.
